intent.problem: Exact two-decimal comparison exposed that local macOS coverage of 85.0013 percent was not portable: the same commit measured 84.95 percent on hosted Linux and failed after 21 minutes. The existing aggregate PR exception also models only one pair, so it cannot safely close a second discovered recovery without either rewriting evidence or weakening ownership.
constraints: Keep the declared policy floor at 85 percent and add an explicit operational safety buffer.
Increase deterministic test coverage rather than excluding files or platform branches.
Preserve immutable archive evidence and require every recovery-chain edge to satisfy the existing strict pair predicates.
Do not resume performance implementation until this corrective passes hosted CI and closes.
intent.rationale: A small executable buffer prevents near-threshold local results from being promoted as portable evidence, while pairwise validation generalizes the existing narrow recovery exception without authorizing unrelated bundled Work Items.
